summary:
Fixed the settings button placement and responsiveness:
1. Re-architected HUD top header layout to use explicit safe margins (top-2 left-2 right-2) with compact pill sizing and icon-only profile on mobile, eliminating horizontal overflow that was pushing the settings button past the right edge of the screen.
2. Made the settings button shrink-0, golden-bordered, and permanently anchored inside the visible mobile screen.
3. Added a quick-access Settings button directly inside the ControlDock footer utility strip next to the 2X deal speed toggle.
4. Added the Settings button to the TitleScreen glass bar.
